description:
Non material amendment to planning reference 24/2777/FUL  to allow change of wording to condition 36 to: C36. Number of students and staff

1.       If student numbers enrolled at St Mary's University exceed 5427, a revised Transport Statement and scheme for additional cycle parking and any other appropriate mitigation, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

2.       There shall be no increase in student numbers beyond 5427 until the revised Transport Statement and appropriate mitigation has been approved and implemented in full.

REASON: To ensure the development does not have an inacceptable impact on highway conditions and residential amenity.
decision_conditions: In line with the email Lucy Thatcher email sent to Chris Paget, NMA must be submitted with a 'sworn declaration' that student numbers were as set out in their submission with the peak as 5427
